title: One workspace. Your way.
summary: A redesigned workspace brings your portfolio, market discovery, settings and investment copilot together, with a new dark theme and familiar lavender accents.

items.title: Your portfolio in focus
items.description: See your portfolio history above your holdings in a clearer overview, with compact navigation and more room for the information you follow.

items.title: Keep your copilot beside you
items.description: Open Ask Oren in a resizable panel alongside the desktop workspace. On smaller screens, navigating to another page closes the copilot so your destination stays visible.

items.title: Settings, together
items.description: Manage your account, interests, email preferences and agent connections from one settings area. Related themes now sit beneath their sectors, giving you more specific interests to follow.

items.title: Light, dark or your system
items.description: Choose an appearance from the header. Oren remembers your choice and adapts the workspace, charts and copilot while keeping its lavender accents.

video.label: Portfolio, Markets, Settings, dark mode and copilot in Oren, a 10-second workspace reveal
video.caption: One workspace. Your way. A tour of Portfolio, Markets, Settings, dark mode and Ask Oren, with portfolio balances hidden.
